gaps.explanation: Nothing is missing or doubled. Statement p6 (Road-Bridge Sinking Fund column and Total) prints Bond proceeds 3,860,000, Premium on bond issuance 78,136 and Debt issuance costs (27,986); the JSON statement records Bond proceeds as debt_proceeds 3,860,000 and the premium net of costs as other_financing 50,150 (= 78,136 - 27,986). Detail holds the same three printed rows from the Road-Bridge Sinking Fund budgetary schedule p16 (Bond proceeds 3,860,000, Premium on bond issuance 78,136, Bond issuance costs (27,986)), all in section other financing, and the gap check counts all three as debt proceeds: 3,860,000 + 78,136 - 27,986 = 3,910,150. 3,910,150 - 3,860,000 = 50,150 = the statement's other_financing line. Statement debt_proceeds + other_financing = 3,910,150 = schedule (p6 Total other financing sources 3,910,150 less net transfers 0). Classification only; no detail fix.
